where.zh: 比賽關卡（旋轉大道、真假門門、跳跳轉盤）
where.en: Rounds after GO! (Spin Avenue, Fake Doors, Bounce Wheel)

harness.init: window.S = new M.Sound(); window.S.init(); window.S.musicOn = true;
harness.notes: Exports class Sound only (no imports). music(on, fast) runs a setInterval at step*1000 ms (0.18 s normal, 0.14 s final) and plays each note at ctx.currentTime, so it relies on virtual setInterval timing. 16-step pattern: 16*0.18 = 2.88 s, fast 16*0.14 = 2.24 s.

notes: Very short loop; game started it at the GO! countdown (js/main.js:355) with R.D.final for the hex round. The hi-hat noise ticks go to master, not the music bus.
